simulator.name: sionna-hybrid
simulator.label: Ray tracing + P.526 profile diffraction
simulator.notes: Sionna RT over 30 m terrain and Microsoft ML building footprints, all four sites and twelve sectors at 36.576 m, corrected by ITU-R P.526 knife-edge diffraction (Deygout, 4/3-earth) on the 3DEP profile where the tracer finds no path.
